nodes.text: [i]A long green mat runs out under a wall of black. The air smells of cut paper. Something enormous stands in the middle of it, unfinished: half colored, half sketch, with a pair of shears where its hands should be.[/i]

nodes.speaker: The Scissor-Man
nodes.text: Cut for length. Cut for 'it doesn't serve the story.'

nodes.speaker: The Scissor-Man
nodes.text: Everything has a page count. Yours is up.
[i]Every cut leaves a clipping behind. Strike a clipping to pick it up, and press [V] to paste it back. Paper that has been patched, scissors will not cut.[/i]
